catalyst_rows.indication: advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma (Phase 2a full efficacy results)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: As a substantial proportion of patients remain on treatment, full efficacy analyses, including progression-free survival and overall survival, top-line results are expected in the coming months and will be presented in a forthcoming clinical conference.

Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd. ... today announced plans to advance its pancreatic cancer program into a Phase 2b study evaluating Namodenoson in combination with immunotherapy in patients with advanced pancreatic cancer. ... details of the planned Phase 2b study design are expected to be discussed during the upcoming BIO International Convention in San Diego.
